$comment: Street material sources (tools/textures/pack_ground.py). Albedo by Z-Image Turbo (`img`, 4-bit mflux, 1024 px), normal and height by DeepBump (`texmaps`). highpass: px of the periodic high-pass on normal and height.

surfaces.name: asphalt
surfaces.prompt: old dark grey road asphalt seen from directly above, fine gravel aggregate, small tar-sealed hairline cracks, slightly worn, flat even overcast light
surfaces.notes: Seamless by image quilting (make-tileable). Seeds 21 and 23 showed darker bands along the quilting seams.

surfaces.name: paving
surfaces.prompt: texture photo, worn grey square concrete paving slabs of a city sidewalk seen from directly above, orthographic, perfectly straight aligned grid of joints parallel to the image edges, dirty grout joints, faint stains, flat even overcast light
surfaces.command: img "<prompt>" -s 42, then cropped to 2 x 2 slabs between joint centres (source px x 335.5-1023.5, y 331.3-1023.5) and resized to 1024
surfaces.notes: Not quilted: --tile (seeds 31-33) cut through slabs and stepped the joints at its seam; a crop on joint centres puts the wrap inside a joint. 2 x 2 slabs per tile.
